Create one independently randomized, complex photorealistic test scene in which old-growth forest structure remains the primary readable subject while an adult whose general visible appearance is guided by the supplied portrait performs a small, coherent field action; the resulting pixels must permit strict observation of the environmental structure rather than merely naming it.

Create a photorealistic wide horizontal ecological field photograph in a rain-cleared temperate old-growth rainforest. Old-growth forest structure is the primary subject: young saplings, mid-sized mature trees, and massive ancient trunks form clearly different living-tree cohorts; low understory foliage, a broken mid-canopy, and high crowns create distinct vertical canopy layers around one open gap. A tall barkless standing dead snag remains fully visible, while a huge moss-covered fallen nurse log crosses the foreground with rooted seedlings growing from its decaying wood. At the near end of the log, an unmistakably adult field observer, guided by the provided appearance reference with general facial continuity and long dark softly waved hair, kneels in practical neutral field clothing and photographs the seedlings. Keep the observer small and offset so every structural feature stays unobstructed. Clearing rain leaves wet bark, luminous moss, suspended mist, and cloud-filtered midday light. Use a 24 mm full-frame perspective, deep focus, natural color, credible scale, and connected foreground-to-canopy depth.
